summary: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a successful live demonstration of its DefendAir counter-UAS system in France. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No financial terms, M&A activity, shareholder vote, or special-situation catalyst is disclosed. It merely informs the market of the company's operational progress in marketing its product. As such, this is not a special situation event.
